note: A post-hoc diagnostic written after the validator's first stage; it is not a leg, moves no bound and changes no status. It asks which implementation is right in the statement of D8b.r2 with the largest deviance difference.

statement.ensemble: the oracle's numpy ensemble of U3c

independent.method: numpy only: EM to a fixed point (steps below 1e-15) for the unconstrained and the constrained maximum, and scipy.optimize trust-constr from three starts for the constrained maximum

reading: The oracle's deviance is the right one. Bin 5 is zero at the unconstrained maximum and 0.49 listings at the constrained one; the prototype starts its constrained fit from the maximum with a zero bin raised to 1e-9 and stops on the change of the log-likelihood, so it stops before that bin has grown, underestimates the constrained maximum and reports a deviance 0.027 too large. 4 of the 4,000 cross-fed statements differ by more than 1e-6 and 3 by more than 1e-3; no status and no covering flag differs.
